self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Timeless Dream: Eternal Stove (R1): gain 30% Energy Recharge for 12s after using an Elemental Burst (50% at R5). A toggle, as in GO, rather than always on. The ER it grants also feeds the passive's ATK-from-ER conversion, which reads total ER after every bonus. Boards saved before 2026-10-14 had the ER always on and were backfilled with this condition ticked so their scores did not move.

source.note: Timeless Dream: Eternal Stove (R1, Amber affix 113509 upgrade[0]): 'ATK increased by 28% of Energy Recharge over the base 100%. You can gain a maximum bonus of 80% ATK. Gain 30% Energy Recharge for 12s after using an Elemental Burst.' The ATK-from-ER conversion uses new eval-time stat-conversion keys atk_from_enerRech_/atk_from_enerRech_cap_ (added 2026-07-15 to damage_evaluator_service.py/damage_evaluator_batch_service.py, mirroring the existing <element>_dmg_from_enerRech_ pattern but targeting atk_ instead). The 30% ER-after-burst proc is the self conditional engulfing_lightning_after_burst_er (always-on until 2026-10-14), and its ER also feeds the ATK conversion since apply_bonus_modifiers merges it before apply_stat_conversions runs.
